title: With a high ro! and a randy ro! and my galloping tearing tandy O!
html_source: These lines are from a sea chanty called “Galloping Randy Dandy O.” (Richard K. Bass, “Additional Allusions in "Eumaeus”)

anchor.text: With a high ro! and a randy ro! and my galloping tearing tandy O!
anchor.prefix: be, the publican of the Crown and Anchor, in shirtsleeves, eating rumpsteak and onions. No chair for father. Boo! The wind! Her brandnew arrival is on her knee, post mortem child.
anchor.suffix:
Bow to the inevitable. Grin and bear it. I remain with much love your brokenhearted husband, W. B. Murphy.

The sailor, who scarcely seemed to be a Dublin resident, turned to one
